description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Model::RecipeImporter' class, which encapsulates the business logic for importing recipes into different projects within the Coocook application. It manages source and target articles, units, ingredients, and handles the import process including candidate identification and data copying.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::RecipeImporter
classes.description: A class implementing the logic for importing recipes into different projects, including candidate identification and data copying.

methods.name: _build_ingredients
methods.description: Builds and returns the sorted ingredients of the recipe.

methods.name: _build_source_articles
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of source articles related to the recipe's ingredients.

methods.name: _build_source_units
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of source units related to the recipe's ingredients.

methods.name: _build_target_articles
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of target articles from the project.

methods.name: _build_target_units
methods.description: Builds and returns a list of target units from the project.

methods.name: BUILD
methods.description: Initializes the ingredient hashrefs with corresponding source articles and units.

methods.name: identify_candidates
methods.description: Identifies candidate target articles and units for source ingredients based on matching keys.

methods.name: import_data
methods.description: Performs the import of recipe data into the target project, creating new recipes and copying ingredients.
